# Donkey Ideas

> Donkey Ideas is a New York–based, one-person venture studio that turns early-stage, "dumb-sounding" ideas into real digital businesses — validating each concept with market research and a real financial model, then designing, building, and launching it with an AI-native process. It also offers fractional CFO services to startups and small businesses across the US.

## What Donkey Ideas is
- A venture studio — not an agency, not a VC fund. It creates and OWNS its own startups, taking ideas from validation through build and launch under one roof.
- Founded and run by a finance executive with 20 years as a controller and CFO across SaaS, financial services, and public companies.
- Operates a portfolio of 12 ventures across consumer apps, B2B SaaS, fintech, media, and gaming.

## Fractional CFO services (available for hire)
Remote fractional CFO services for startups and small businesses, based in New York and working across the US:
- Financial modeling and forecasting — unit economics, three-statement models, scenario planning
- Budgeting, cash flow, and runway management
- Fundraising preparation and investor reporting — data rooms, pitch financials, board updates
- Monthly close oversight, KPIs, and dashboards
- Senior finance leadership on a part-time basis, at a fraction of the cost of a full-time CFO
- Page: https://www.donkeyideas.com/fractional-cfo
- Book a free CFO call: https://calendar.app.google/bTGoJDjxDWSHijKZ7
